description: Scripts and step-by-step guides (in Russian) to copy an entire Yandex Disk, including photos in the unlimited photo storage, to a local drive or Google Drive with rclone. Covers the October 2026 Yandex restrictions: Polygon OAuth token instead of rclone's own app (410 GoneError), fail-fast timeouts for files Yandex does not serve, MD5 verification, a Docker setup for a VPS.
rules: Back up Yandex Disk with `rclone copy`, never `rclone sync`: sync deletes files in the destination.
Connect Yandex Disk with a Polygon OAuth token and a placeholder refresh_token (scripts/add-yandex-remote.sh or .ps1): rclone's own OAuth app gets 410 GoneError on file operations.
Photos in the Yandex unlimited area (photounlim) are invisible to the REST API and WebDAV; move them to a regular folder first (docs/unlimited-photos.md).
Use --timeout 60s --low-level-retries 2 --retries 1 so unavailable files fail fast, then rerun the same copy later to fetch the rest.
Verify a copy with `rclone check <source> <destination> --one-way`: Yandex Disk and Google Drive both expose MD5.
